title: Inbox Zero
summary: Merlin Mann's 2007 Google Tech Talk on Inbox Zero, covering Getting Things Done, why an empty inbox matters, and strategies for handling high-volume email. It is a talk on attention and processing mail rather than on emptying it for its own sake.
why: Cited as the original Inbox Zero talk, and for Mann's point that optimizing how you organize tasks is no substitute for doing them.

quote.text: lifehacking is similar to optimizing the process of taking orders and organizing them, but at some point those orders actually need to be fulfilled
